venue.zh: 温布利 / JFK 体育场（全球转播）

summary.en: An afternoon when rock tries to be a planet-wide TV ritual—and a few minutes become immortal gossip.
summary.zh: 一个下午，摇滚试图成为行星级电视仪式——有几分钟变成不朽八卦。

whyEpic.en: Live Aid is charity, broadcast engineering, and stadium craft colliding. Memory cheats: many acts play, but culture keeps a handful of clips. On this chronicle we keep the hinge—global rock as shared weather—without pretending we can stream the whole day.
whyEpic.zh: Live Aid 是慈善、转播工程与体育馆手艺的相撞。记忆会作弊：很多人上台，文化只留下几段。本编年史保留枢纽——全球摇滚如共享天气——但不假装能播整天。

note.en: Many acts; memory often collapses to a few iconic minutes.
note.zh: 多队上场；记忆常坍缩成几分钟经典。

rightsNote.en: Broadcast rights are locked down. No full embeds here—seek official remasters.
rightsNote.zh: 转播权锁死。此处不嵌整场——请找官方重制。
